sentBody:
Hi Reid,

Thank you.

My process is actually more like I use Claude to look at my YouTube watch history, download the video, extract the sentences, and then make me sentence cards for any words that I don't know.

Basically, Anki is like my source of truth for all the words I know and don't know, and then Claude basically finds missing words from things.

I'm also trying to make an extension whereby I can scroll YouTube and it will automatically show me the difficulty of any video.

So it basically helps me decide what to watch and prevents me from watching things that are too easy for me and accidentally wasting my time when things are too hard for me. I can show you in person if I come to one of the events.

I'll check the event link too :)

Best,
Ray

I agree that rigid spec-driven systems can get in the way, especially
when the thing is only half-formed. It really helps to feel at the

I think for me, I just kind of imagine like different layers of loops
because some people run really short, simple loops, such as a cron job
to manage their emails, and other people run more complicated loops
that are like collecting feedback, handing off work to other loops,
and building features end-to-end kinda like the attached images.

I think some confusion can arise when some people are talking about
like layer five loops and other people are talking about like layer
two loops, for example.

Best,

subject: Re: HyperWhisper
sentBody:
Hi,

Thank you for the email.

HyperWhisper the license itself is free and included. But HyperWhisper Cloud isn’t.

Essentially, if you prefer using cloud providers then you have the option of using your own API key or using HyperWhisper Cloud. Or using local models.

When using HyperWhisper Cloud, rather than having a monthly subscription. You pay exactly what we pay to the upstream providers (like ElevenLabs or Groq). There’s no markup.

It’s uneconomical to have HyperWhisper Cloud free forever. People instead prefer a pay as you go approach for their actual usage instead of a subscription.

Hope that makes sense :)

Best,

Ray

subject: Re: HyperWhisper Support Request
sentBody:
Hi Jeff,

Thanks for the report.

I think it's because you have Warp also set to use STT. Warp has a built-in STT too which uses a default key of FN too.

So you're seeing both the HyperWhisper STT and the Warp STT. You're triggering both at the same time.

You can disable it in Warp settings here for "Voice Input".

Best,
Ray
